title: US sailor’s father detained by ICE while son serves aboard USS Abraham Lincoln

This incident has raised eyebrows amid heightened scrutiny surrounding the USS Abraham Lincoln's prolonged deployment.

title: In 2011, 75 tonnes of poisoned bait left just 60-80 rats alive; they rebounded
content: Conservationists attempted a large-scale rat eradication on Henderson Island in 2011.  About seventy-five tonnes of poisoned bait were spread across the remote South Pacific island.  However, a small number of rats survived the intensive campaign.  Within two years, the rat population had recovered significantly to former levels.  This event underscores the difficulty of achieving complete eradication and the resilience of invasive species.

title: California farmers battle Argentine ants that protect other crop pests
content: Invasive Argentine ants have formed a unique symbiotic relationship with sap-feeding insects, creating challenges for citrus groves and vineyards. First spotted in the U.S. in 1891, their expansion is aided by California's favorable climate and human activity. To effectively manage the situation, it's crucial to tackle both the ant populations and their pest partners as interconnected issues.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years
content: The Primary School, founded by Priscilla Chan, has closed after a decade of operation.  Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, leading to the board's decision.  Academic results fell short of state benchmarks and leadership expectations.  Around 540 students will now join the Ravenswood City Elementary School District.  The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative provided financial support for the transition and student savings.

title: After Australia, New Zealand proposes social media ban for under 16

This legislation aims to protect young people from harmful online content and addictive technologies.  However, two coalition parties oppose the bill, which may require opposition support to pass.  Australia enacted a similar ban in December 2025, with other nations considering such measures.  New Zealand also banned mobile phones in schools for all students during the day.

title: In Pulwama, one man’s big bet on cricket and all eyes are on it across J&K

content: televisionK supporters are projecting a role in national politics . the actor-turned-politician said his leadership could have national ambitions . but the numbers in Parliament would ultimately determine who could become Prime Minister . he said the number in parliament would determine who would become prime minister .

title: Manipur violence: Houses burnt, CRPF jawan injured in gunfight in Senapati
content: houses were set ablaze after miscreants torched a house in taphou Kuki village in Kangpokpi district around 2:30 am . a CRPF personnel was injured in a gunfight between two groups in Taphou Naga area .

title: Yogi vs Congress over 'fish feast' in Ayodhya: 'Even chameleon would be put to shame'
content: the controversy erupted after a video surfaced showing fish being prepared at a banquet hall in ayodhya . local religious figures objected to the food arrangements, saying the programme was taking place during the holy month of Sawan . a chameleon would be put to shame by these plight .

title: ‘CTA intentionally prevented’: PTI alleges negligence over Imran Khan’s hospital visit
content: imran Khan's medical care under scrutiny in state-run hospital . the 73-year-old is accused of failing to provide a diagnostic test despite cardiologists warning of potential cardiac complications . a CT Coronary Angiography (CTA) scheduled for Khan was not conducted .

title: 'Normal practice': Govt on Sergio Gor's 'no questions' remark at PM Modi-Trump meet
content: the government said discussions about arrangements for a leader’s public appearance are a “normal practice” ahead of any VVIP visit . the clarification followed statements by US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor at the Economic Times World Leaders Forum on Saturday .

title: After CJP’s drive, Rajasthan unveils Rs 12,500cr school revamp plan
content: JAIPUR: govt has unveiled a three-year, Rs 12,500-crore roadmap for strengthening school infrastructure . announcement comes after a week of opposition and public outcry over restrictions on visiting and filming schools . Ranka alleges 'planned' attack, claims assailants met BJP MLA before assault .

title: ‘Where are the jobs after graduation?’ Kharge attacks BJP govt over unemployment
content: Congress president slammed the PM Modi over unemployment . he cited Niti Aayog and PLFS figures to claim 8.7 crore Indians aged 15 to 29 are neither in education, employment nor training . youth unemployment stands at 15.6% .

title: 'Nation doesn’t have high expectations of you': UP CM Yogi slams Rahul over 'Manusmriti' remarks
content: CM Yogi slams Rahul Gandhi over his remarks on the Manusmriti . he also targets the party's state leadership over its alleged conduct in ayodhya . the party has a responsibility to uphold the Constitution and respect India's traditions .

title: BJP old timers & new entrants clash over Kolkata mutton feast
content: rival BJP factions clashed over a community feast, leaving four injured . the trouble began around 10.30 pm near anandapur grounds . one faction hosted a feast of mutton, katla fish and giant freshwater prawns . local BJP mandal president alias alleged the event was unauthorised .

title: ‘10 cr Indians could lose right to vote’: Chidambaram after ex-envoy’s SIR post
content: ex-diplomat Navdeep Suri detailed difficulties he faced establishing his citizenship during the exercise in Punjab . he questioned what the experience of a common citizen might be if he himself faced difficulties despite having represented the country in three nations . suri said his detainment could leave 10% of the eligible population without the right to vote .
